about_the_game:
Monkey love banana. Banana make monkey brain feel good. That’s science.

Bananaganza is a minimalist, casual arcade game where the only thing that matters is bananas. Forget the corporate grind for a while and focus on something that truly matters: collecting delicious banana slices, watching your score skyrocket, and flexing your reflexes.

“Why collect bananas?” you might ask. Well, bananas are rich in Vitamin B6 and Vitamin C, which (spoiler alert) are great for you. So really, this isn’t a game — it’s a life improvement tool!

Are you ready for the banana beatdown?

Peel. Slice. Collect. Repeat.

In Bananaganza, your ultimate mission is simple: collect as many banana slices as possible. But beware — not all bananas are created equal, and the rotten ones could ruin your fruity fun.

Here’s what you’ll be doing in Bananaganza:

🍌 Peel bananas like a pro.
🍌 Slice them into perfect pieces.
🍌 Catch the flying banana slices before they escape.
🍌 Dodge the rotten bananas.

Who knew fruit could be this intense?

Bananaganza is lovingly crafted by a solo indie developer whose top life goals are creating fun games. Every banana in this game was made with the hope of brightening your day.
detailed_description:
Pre-Launch Wishlist Goals

Bananaganza doesn’t stop here! With enough support, there will be more bananas (and more fun):

🍌 100 wishlists: New objects with unexpected effects.
🍌 200 wishlists: A new unlockable banana level.
🍌 500 wishlists: A brand-new character to cheer you on!
🍌 1000 wishlists: Unleash bizarre banana mayhem!

Wishlisting the game might seem small, but it’s a huge help in bringing these bananas to life! Your support means the world.
